author: GameSpot
description:
Like with Resident Evil Requiem’s Mr. Raccoon, little figurines called Mini Cabins are scattered throughout Pragmata, producing a chime when you’re near them. These statues don’t provide any gameplay modifications; they’re simply for collecting. But there are only three in each of the five main biomes of the game, and most are easy to spot! Here’s a handy guide for tracking down any you have remaining.
